data.summary: E091 discrimination test harness built and validated. Harness fetches MrPLC forum pages, extracts thread titles/view/replies, applies fault_need_classifier, computes G1/G2/G3 gates. G1 (FPR < 0.10) passes consistently across sample sizes (0.000 FPR). G2/G3 failures expected due to domain mismatch (known-served software probes not on MrPLC). Harness is reusable tool for future discrimination tests. E090 fresh observation previously completed with instrument validation and 16-practitioner population measurement (43.8% served). Next: extend population measurement using E091 harness with more practitioner rows.
